applicabilityBasis.summary: CADD is a fully backed, fixed-CAD redeemable stablecoin intended for payments and settlement, so it was reviewed as an apparent payment stablecoin despite its Canadian issuance.

genius.licensingRegulator: Alberta Treasury Board and Finance; Loan and Trust Corporations Act (Alberta)
genius.notes: CADD terms identify Tetra Trust Company as issuer and CAD Digital Inc. solely as its agent. Direct redemption is at CAD1 gross per token, subject to registration, sanctions checks and the greater of CAD50 or 0.25% fee. Public monthly Baker Tilly reports are present. No qualifying public GENIUS permitted-issuer approval, state qualification, pending application or foreign registration was located for CADD/Tetra Trust in the checked sources. GENIUS issuer implementation remains proposed. This pre-effective DASP status does not establish that U.S. distribution is otherwise lawful or that every customer is eligible.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: As of October 7, 2026, the checked issuer disclosures, OCC tracker, NYDFS directory and regulator-domain searches did not identify a qualifying public GENIUS PPSI approval, state qualification, pending GENIUS application or foreign registration for CADD/Tetra Trust Company (through CAD Digital Inc.). Foreign licensing does not satisfy those U.S. requirements. No public U.S. issuer/token enforcement action was located in the specified searches. This finding does not exclude confidential or unindexed filings and does not establish U.S. distribution eligibility.
